text: Stellantis reports €22.3B full-year net loss versus prior-year profit, driven by €25.4B in write-downs tied to electric vehicle strategy. Adjusted operating result shifts to loss. Dividend suspended and hybrid bonds issued. EV capital allocation reduced as technology mix broadens.

meta.note: Loss magnitude dominated by accounting impairments; shipment volume remains reported in second half.

text: Block announces reduction from over 10,000 employees to under 6,000, eliminating more than 4,000 roles. Company expects $450M-$500M in restructuring charges. Shares increase over 24% in extended trading following earnings release and workforce announcement.

meta.note: Price appreciation coincides with headcount reduction; long-term cost impact not quantified beyond charges.

text: Warner Bros. Discovery board determines Paramount Skydance's $31 per share all-cash offer is superior to Netflix's $27.75 per share asset deal. Netflix declines to match and exits transaction. Breakup fees and regulatory conditions disclosed. Shares move divergently in extended trading.

meta.note: Board superiority clause activated; competing transaction formally discontinued.
